name: rigid_tool_meshing_pipeline
goal: Provide a deterministic, validated, and scriptable meshing pipeline for rigid-tool FE meshes.
functional_requirements: Support tool geometry input from either tool_*.txt or TL-angle parameter set.
Support explicit mesh refinement controls (center, diameter, fine size, transition, max size).
Support system-installed Gmsh SDK/module resolution via CLI flags and environment variables.
Produce .msh output compatible with existing FE-tool loader physical groups.
Optionally emit geometry metadata JSON and mesh quality report JSON.
Provide a single pipeline command that validates inputs before meshing.
non_functional_requirements: Keep backward compatibility with current Meshing/generate_rigid_tool_mesh.py behavior.
Fail fast with human-readable validation errors for invalid inputs.
Avoid introducing external Python dependencies beyond the standard library and gmsh module.
Enable incremental extension (preflight checks, multiple targets, batch jobs) without breaking CLI contracts.
initial_scope_boundaries: No replacement of current meshing algorithm internals.
No change to FE-tool solver behavior or physical model interpretation.
No batch scheduler yet; only single-job orchestration.
